semiconductor_relevance: High — Itochu Machine-Technos provides a range of manufacturing and inspection equipment specifically designed for semiconductor processes.
summary: Itochu Machine-Technos exhibits a variety of manufacturing equipment for both front-end and back-end semiconductor processes, including advanced inspection devices. Their offerings include systems for measuring wafer characteristics and automatic defect inspection, catering to the needs of semiconductor manufacturers.
capabilities: Wafer film thickness and surface roughness measurement
Automatic defect inspection systems for wafer thinning
High-speed atomic force microscopy for particle measurement in liquids
Fully automated packaging equipment for FOUPs and FOSBs
